title: AI 改寫可直接對照原文與結果
summary: 改寫時同時閱讀原文與結果，減少切換與記憶比對，並可收合指令區增加閱讀空間。
highlights: 原文與結果依閱讀寬度左右並排或上下排列，各自捲動並提供獨立複製操作。
指令區可收合與展開，保留草稿及改寫歷史。
精簡重複標題，以文字區分管理指令與 AI 服務設定。
usage: 選取文字後開啟 AI 改寫，選擇指令或輸入要求；請先在 AI 服務設定填入服務網址、模型及所需金鑰。可收合指令區放大對照閱讀空間。

en.title: Compare AI rewrites with the original
en.summary: Read the original and result together, and hide commands to make more room for comparison.
highlights: The original and result appear side by side or stacked according to reading width, with independent scrolling and copy actions.
Hide and show commands while keeping your draft and rewrite history.
A compact toolbar replaces the repeated heading, with clear labels for command management and AI service settings.
en.usage: Select text and open AI Rewrite, then choose a command or enter an instruction. First configure your endpoint, model, and required key in AI service settings. Use Hide commands to make more reading room.
